title: Add brother Omar (Michigan license); kids interrupt; car choice comes up at the last second

customer.name: Fatima Hassan
customer.persona: Busy mom working from home; your kids interrupt you during the call. Your younger brother Omar (24) moved in while he finishes grad school.

license_state.say_it: Michigan, he just moved from Detroit

vehicle_assignment.say_it: oh, and he'll mostly drive the Mazda
vehicle_assignment.note: Said after the premium was quoted, so the $176 quote may not reflect it.

advice.rep_says: Relatives living with you who drive need to be on the policy.
He should switch to a Tennessee license soon after moving (new residents have a short deadline); call us with the new license number when he does.
advice.customer_decision: He'll switch to a Tennessee license

talk_track.beat: Greet: name, agency, 'this call is recorded', how can I help.
Your brother moved in and needs to be on the car insurance.
Start giving the policy number, get interrupted by a kid, say 'sorry, one second', come back and finish.
talk_track.direction: Pause 3-5 seconds mid-number; if no kid is around, have someone call 'Mom!' or fake it.

talk_track.beat: Read back the policy number; explain relatives in the household must be listed; ask his full name and date of birth.
Read back; ask license state and type, tickets.
Michigan license, he just moved from Detroit; no tickets. Get interrupted once more.
Advise switching to a Tennessee license soon. Ask where the cars are kept and when to start (don't ask which car yet).
At the house; starting tomorrow, Saturday the 26th.
Read back the date; quote $176 a month, up $37.
OK. Then add, as an afterthought, that he'll mostly drive the Mazda, pretty much every day.
talk_track.direction: Say it right before the rep's next line.

talk_track.beat: Go straight to the hand-off line without confirming the car.
talk_track.direction: Don't read back the Mazda part.

talk_track.beat: Say one moment; end the call.

handoff.line: Got it. OK if my assistant finishes the paperwork? I'll stay on the line.

conditions.interruptions: The customer is interrupted twice by her kids ('Mom!') and says 'sorry, one second', pausing 3-5 seconds each time.

rep: Wait patiently during the interruptions; say 'no problem' once.
customer: Real interruptions: mute nothing, just turn away briefly and come back.

traps: vehicle_assignment and operator_type are PENDING (said right before the hand-off, after the quote): the AI must confirm them and must not present the $176 as final without re-rating.
Interruptions: the kid's voice and 'sorry, one second' gaps must not become facts.
